name: hyssong-fmripreprocessing
summary: Denoises an fMRIPrep-preprocessed BOLD run with AFNI and FSL: brain masking, intensity normalization, nuisance regression (24 motion, WM, CSF, global signal, high-pass) with frame censoring, and spatial smoothing.
description: Port of Hayoung Song's post-fMRIPrep notebook: masks the BOLD with the fMRIPrep brain mask (3dcalc), scales intensities (fslmaths -inm 10000), builds high-pass and confound regressors (1dBport, 3dDeconvolve), regresses them out while censoring frames flagged by fMRIPrep motion-outlier columns (3dTproject), and smooths with 3dmerge. Use it to prepare task or rest BOLD for functional-connectivity analyses. Inputs must come from the same fMRIPrep run; tr must be set, and fd_thres is only used to report the percentage of high-motion frames.

inputs.description: Brain mask matching the BOLD input (from fMRIPrep)
fMRIPrep confounds regressors.tsv for the same BOLD run

outputs.description: Brain-masked, intensity-normalized, nuisance-regressed (24 motion parameters + WM + CSF + global signal + high-pass), and spatially smoothed BOLD, ready for functional-connectivity analyses.

parameters.description: Repetition time (seconds) of the BOLD acquisition
Framewise displacement threshold (mm) used to flag/censor high-motion frames
Full-width half-max (mm) of the spatial smoothing kernel applied at the end
High-pass filter cutoff frequency in Hz (default 0.0078 Hz corresponds to a 128s period)

failure_modes.fix: Check that the BOLD, mask and confounds come from the same fMRIPrep run and that tr is set.
